sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is semantically supported because approvalEvidence is only a class, while hasEvidence ranges to evidenceArtifact and provides no canonical owner-compatible path pairing each material with its approvingAuthority, approvalStandard, approved status, and polarServiceTemperature basis.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The shape does not faithfully encode that each exposed machinery or foundation material has approval based on the polar service temperature: it only asserts independent ship-level presence of a material, approval status, authority, standard, and PST, with no qualified approval/material-certificate relationship or per-material pairing. Locate or supply canonical terms and paths for the approval evidence and its material/PST basis, then constrain every applicable material approval to the authorized authority and standard alternatives while preserving that pairing.
